performance.scope: Backend algorithms on synthetic arrays; excludes file decoding, UI and upstream comparison.

limitations: All analysis fixtures are explicitly synthetic; no user experimental data was used.
No Windows native launch, DLL loading, default browser association, font or Office acceptance has been executed.
No claim of biological accuracy, laboratory validation or upstream performance superiority.
browser_retry_notes: The official Chrome headless shell was used after system Chromium failed to create its desktop singleton socket.
The resize/input test now waits for both the committed column setting and positioned grid, preventing assertions on a transient auto-grid.
